searchText: Dumb Q, are light clients of older versions affected by hard forks? Since they don't perform full validation, would old versions simply carry on as though nothing happened? If it depends on the details of the hard fork, let's take London and Berlin for example. yes it would depend on the light client design and the details of the fork if you have a proof-of-work light client just following the header chain, a lot could change for full nodes and the light client could keep chugging along w/ London in particular we are adding a new field, the base fee, to the header which could imply a light client would need to be updated to validate these new headers Anyone know why https://kovan.etherscan.io/ seems to be stalled? Hasn't discovered a new block in 3+ hours. I don't run Kovan but I can ask Etherscan. <@418000431814279181> thx, i couldn't figure out how to do that. <@418000431814279181> looks like it's back up, so maybe don't worry about it. I appreciate the quick help though

If it depends on the details of the hard fork, let's take London and Berlin for example.

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: yes it would depend on the light client design and the details of the fork

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: if you have a proof-of-work light client just following the header chain, a lot could change for full nodes and the light client could keep chugging along

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: w/ London in particular we are adding a new field, the base fee, to the header which could imply a light client would need to be updated to validate these new headers
